what: Throughout the timeline section a big year (16rem accent color) stays pinned at the screen center. While the top edge of the cell where the year changes travels from the bottom of the screen to the center (scrub .5), the current year slides out 100% upward and the next year rises from 100% below to take its place — only the year rolls over while the photo·text cells pass by. If the same year continues, it does not flip

options.start: Swap start position (relative to the cell), default top bottom
options.end: Position once fully changed, default top center
options.[data-fx-part=counter]: Year plate attached to the screen (if left empty, the part fills in the year)
